changes.title: Custom rules configuration
changes.text: Added the immutable 18-setting custom-rules foundation with provisional upgrade-scroll counts from 1 to 60; gameplay sliders are not available yet.

changes.title: Original score protection
changes.text: Added scoring records that retain original earned scores and distinguish neutral settings, unknown historical settings and pending calibration; earned-score behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: Custom rules save checks
changes.text: Added boundary, immutable-setting, historical-unknown and actual game-save/load tests, including every upgrade-scroll count and all six classes.

changes.title: Research and verification records
changes.text: Recorded the recovered scoring-research constraints, unfinished integration work and build verification requirements.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added the custom-rules save foundation without changing earned scores. Gameplay effects, the settings interface and complete UIMSD integration remain in development.
